summary: Iteration 2 focused on the newly wired shared modules: Admin Properties (CRUD + status + verify + filters), Property Verification queue, Agents (list/create/verify/delete + verified filter + listings_count), Platform Users (suspend/reactivate) and the public no-auth AMASS-app endpoints (/api/public/properties with filters, /api/public/properties/{id} 404-for-non-approved, /api/public/properties POST creates pending, /api/public/agents returns only verified). Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 5 new test classes (TestProperties, TestAgents, TestPlatformUsers, TestPublicApp, TestRBACNew) — pytest total: 49 passed, 0 failed. Also fixed 2 stale CMS asserts (partners section renamed/removed in current seed) which were unrelated to this iteration but blocking green. Playwright end-to-end verified: login as super_admin, Properties page loads 38 rows, filters work (status=approved -> 18 rows), create-property dialog works and new listing appears in the search / gets deleted, Property Verification page shows queue+verified tabs, Agents page loads with Add button, Users page loads 52 rows with Suspend/Reactivate visible. RBAC verified: content_manager gets 403 on /api/properties & /api/agents; finance gets 403 on /api/properties.

issues: Recharts still emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on first paint (cosmetic, self-heals) — carried over from iteration 1
Radix warning: DialogContent missing `Description`/`aria-describedby` — accessibility nit

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription to Properties New-Property dialog to silence Radix warning.
(Carryover) server.py now 1106 lines — split into routers (properties, agents, platform_users, public) to stay maintainable.
critical_code_review_comments: Properties list endpoint has no verified-filter documented in the property-verification page UI but the backend supports ?verified=true/false — good; keep in sync.

public POST /api/public/properties accepts an arbitrary agent_id from anonymous callers with no validation that the agent exists — an attacker can inject any string; consider validating agent_id against db.agents or ignoring the field on the public endpoint.
public POST /api/public/properties has no rate-limit / anti-spam and no captcha — will get flooded in production. Same latent risk as POST /api/public/leads.
server.py grew to 1106 lines (was 719); the file-size threshold (>700) is exceeded — recommend splitting into modular routers before adding Transactions/Payments modules.

PropertyInput used both for admin and public creation — same shape; that is fine, but the public one should perhaps have a stricter schema (no image URLs from arbitrary hosts, capped price ranges, etc.).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows for Properties / Verification / Agents / Users
